summary: fix(anylist): make generated command probes JSON-safe and cache-tolerant
reason: The generated CLI's full dogfood matrix exposed shared baseline issues: dry-run JSON commands emitted no payload, empty local caches printed prose under --json, punctuation broke FTS prefix searches, help omitted examples, and an unknown read-only list caused a probe failure.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood passed 171/171 tests; complete Go test suite and diff checks also passed.
